haiku.problem: The wrong answer "Called him away" is longer than the other two answers and adds "away," which makes it the odd one out in length and form. The right answer's form is "Blessed him," so the wrong answers should match it more closely.

Hagar's name is a smaller detail than the passage's main events. Abraham's death (Genesis 25:7-8) and his burial with Sarah in the cave of Machpelah (Genesis 25:9-10) are more important, and neither is asked on any trivia question.
